잠언 21:1.content: The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.

잠언 21:2.content: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the Lord pondereth the hearts.

잠언 21:3.content: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.

잠언 21:4.content: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.

잠언 21:5.content: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.

잠언 21:6.content: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.

잠언 21:7.content: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.

잠언 21:8.content: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.

잠언 21:9.content: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.

잠언 21:10.content: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.

잠언 21:11.content: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

잠언 21:12.content: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.

잠언 21:13.content: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.

잠언 21:14.content: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.

잠언 21:15.content: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

잠언 21:16.content: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.

잠언 21:17.content: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

잠언 21:18.content: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.

잠언 21:19.content: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.

잠언 21:20.content: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.

잠언 21:21.content: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.

잠언 21:22.content: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.

잠언 21:23.content: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.

잠언 21:24.content: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.

잠언 21:25.content: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.

잠언 21:26.content: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.

잠언 21:27.content: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?

잠언 21:28.content: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.

잠언 21:29.content: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.

잠언 21:30.content: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the Lord.

잠언 21:31.content: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the Lord.
